name: cli-prototype-self-review-gate
description: M20 Q6: the enforced self-review gate before final delivery. One CLI inbound drives a scripted tool loop: scaffold and commit a tiny project (git init), make a further uncommitted edit, record and run a one-stage `.copperclaw/verify` (so the PRE-EXISTING M20 Q2 verify gate reads clean and only the NEW Q6 review gate is under test), attempt to complete the only (therefore final) todo (REFUSED: never self-reviewed), call `self_review` to read the diff since the project's first commit, submit `no_findings: true` (writes `.copperclaw/reviewed`), then attempt completion again (ALLOWED). Proves the refuse -> self_review (read) -> self_review (submit) -> completion shape genuinely occurs through the real pipeline. Registered in tests/replay.rs via the same subprocess re-exec X2/M20X1 used (forbid(unsafe_code) blocks std::env::set_var). See README.md.
